The main takeaway from our work is that

we have shown that a simple model, based only on the dose-volume histogram (DVH) of the rectum, can predict the risk of rectal toxicity for prostate cancer patients undergoing intensity-modulated radiation therapy (IMRT).

the current practice of external beam photon radiation treatment for localized prostate cancer can be improved by using the dose-volume histogram (DVH) to optimize the plan, and by using the uncomplicated and cancer-free (UCCF) control probability (CPP) as a measure of the quality of the plan.
